topic: Other tests still fail now and then under parallel load
detail: While SP-082 looped go test -count=1 ./... for load, 2 of about 36 full-suite runs failed outside SP-082's tests: once TestHTTPDownload/success_writes_file (internal/model or internal/qdrant), once a test whose log was not kept. Proposed: a follow-up feature to find and fix them as SP-082 did.
